channel.description: Latest articles from The Oakland Press (theoaklandpress.com)

item.title: US vs. Canada for Olympic gold is a titanic showdown of hockey powerhouses
item.description: Dylan Larkin has been thinking about the U.S. facing Canada for gold at the Olympics for a year. All the dreams he had as a kid crystalized after he and his teammates lost to their rival in the final of the 4 Nations Face-Off.

item.title: OU grant program awards funding to local projects
item.description: Although two awards were originally planned, the committee identified three projects that clearly rose to the top.

item.title: OU creates award to honor late administrator
item.description: Individuals may be nominated by students, colleagues, supervisors or administrators.

item.title: Authorities say Super Bowl-timed human trafficking sweeps net dozens of arrests, rescues in Bay Area
item.description: A Santa Clara County task force announced that a regional crackdown led to 29 arrests and 73 rescues, and that heavy enforcement will accompany World Cup festivities in June.

item.title: Cameron Boozer and No. 3 Duke knock off No. 1 Michigan 68-63 as top 2 teams lose on same day
item.description: Cameron Boozer scored 18 points and No. 3 Duke handed another neutral-site loss to fellow blueblood Michigan, knocking off the top-ranked Wolverines 68-63 on Saturday night in a raucous possible Final Four preview in the nation’s capital.

item.title: Kevin McGonigle makes early statement as Tigers stumble in opener
item.description: Let’s start with the good, because it’s brief. Rookie shortstop Kevin McGonigle smoked an opposite-field single in his first at-bat of spring training. Veteran outfielder Corey Julks homered. There were a handful of solid defensive plays.That about covers it.

item.title: Duren with 26 points, 13 rebounds in return, Pistons top Bulls 126-110 for 5th straight win
item.description: Jalen Duren had 26 points and 13 rebounds in his return from a suspension to help the Detroit Pistons take charge in the second half and roll to a 126-110 victory over the Chicago Bulls on Saturday night.

item.title: Photos of Orchard Lake St. Mary’s and Ann Arbor Father Gabriel Richard in a D3 hockey regional
item.description: Orchard Lake St. Mary's defeated Ann Arbor Father Gabriel Richard 10-2 in the MHSAA D3 regional semifinal played at OLSM on Saturday.

item.title: Orchard Lake St. Mary’s hangs 10 goals on Father Gabriel Richard in playoff opener
item.description: The Orchard Lake St. Mary’s Eaglets opened the defense of their D3 state title by rolling to a 10-2 victory over the Ann Arbor Father Gabriel Richard Fighting Irish.
